title: docs(qa): a verification re-run files no qa-run record; sweeps still file one per run
body:
Fixes #24173
Clause-②: no

Docs-only follow-up to maintainer ruling **C** on #24127 (ruling record `6230593290`, the maintainer's choice verbatim: 「C 有问题才开卡 (Recommended)」). The checklist-test skill half merged as `b0fe9fad47` (#24172). Three `domain:devx` documents that the skill tells its runner to read first still said that **every** completed run files a `qa-run` issue. A runner that obeyed them would file the record the ruling says not to file.

## What changes (three record-filing sentences, nothing else in those files)

| File | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` (Run records, first paragraph) | 「Every completed run — **pass or fail alike** — files **one GitHub issue** …」 | Every completed **sweep run** (a release candidate, an area or `all` run, or a maintainer-named target) files one `qa-run` issue. **A verification re-run files none**: a run whose trigger is the same PR's ledger edit of that item. Its per-item verdict table goes in the PR body, and the item's `history` row carries the PR as its `ref`. A `partial` / `blocked` gap goes in the PR body and in `fixtures.knownGaps`. A product-defect `fail` is still extracted as its own card, pointing at the PR. A stale clause is fixed in the same diff. The sentence points at `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §5, 「验证重测」. |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/runs/README.md` L11–12 | 「every completed run files one `qa-run` GitHub issue」 | Every completed sweep run (same three kinds) files one. A verification re-run files none: its evidence is the PR body and the item's `history` row, and a `partial` / `blocked` gap also goes in `fixtures.knownGaps`. It defers to RUNNER.md, Run records, for the full exception. The list lead-in becomes "A sweep's record:". |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` (How a release sweep works) | 「every run files one `qa-run` GitHub issue」 | 「every sweep run files one」, plus one sentence after it: a verification re-run (triggered by the same PR's ledger edit of that item) files no record, and its evidence is the PR body and the item's `history` row (RUNNER.md, Run records). |

Unchanged, per the card's boundary: RUNNER.md's title grammar (「The record title」), its label discipline (`qa-run` and nothing else) and its extraction obligation section. No gate is added.

## Agreement with the merged skill text (acceptance 1)

Each clause of the skill's paragraph at `origin/main` `d537a318b3` (`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` L223–225, §5), set against RUNNER.md's new sentence:

| Skill clause | RUNNER.md |
|---|---|
| 由同一 PR 对该项的清单编辑(§3)引发,⛔ 不立 `qa-run` 记录 | "A verification re-run files none — a run whose trigger is the same PR's ledger edit of that item" |
| 逐项判定表进 PR 正文 | "Its per-item verdict table goes in the PR body" |
| 该项 `history` 行的 `ref` 指向该 PR | "the item's `history` row carries the PR as its `ref`" |
| `partial`/`blocked` 的缺口进 PR 正文与 `fixtures.knownGaps` | "a `partial` or `blocked` gap goes in the PR body and the item's `fixtures.knownGaps`" |
| 产品缺陷 `fail` 照常抽卡、溯源指向该 PR | "a product-defect `fail` is still extracted as its own card, pointing at the PR" |
| 条款过期在同一 diff 修 | "a stale clause is fixed in the same diff" |
| §4: 整轮运行(发版候选、区或 `all`、维护者点名目标)恰好立一张 | "Every completed sweep run (a release candidate, an area or `all` run, or a maintainer-named target) … files one GitHub issue" |

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`, measured. `docs/qa/**` sits at the repo root. The root `package.json` is `private: true`, and no package manifest references `platform-checklist`. Control: `git grep '"files"'` over `packages/*/package.json` hits 74 manifests. Nothing in this diff ships in any published tarball.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling item 1's letter reads "files no `qa-run` record when every clause passes" and then covers `partial` / `blocked` and the two kinds of `fail` one by one. The merged skill states the no-record rule for every verification re-run, with the product-defect `fail` going to a card that points at the PR. These docs follow the merged skill text, as acceptance 1 requires.
